dedupe_keys.name: data for cosmo bep tree v1 0 a coupled urban climate model with explicit representation of street trees

description: The COSMO-BEP-Tree research team publishes input data, observations, processed model outputs and post-processing scripts for a Basel urban-heat study. Zenodo provides five archives under CC BY 4.0. The deposit lists building-geometry shapefiles, tree and imperviousness rasters, a Landsat scene, model namelists, observation text files and processed output arrays. These materials can benchmark coupled tree-canopy and urban-atmosphere simulations during the June–July 2015 heatwave. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Basel package. Coverage is the study area and event, not a generic urban-climate data service. A limitation is that full three-dimensional outputs and boundary conditions are not in the public archives and were described as available only by request; the available arrays support narrower checks. Geometry and vegetation representation can alter simulated thermal effects. No archive was downloaded, and no climate-model run or figure was reproduced.
